userStories.title: Add task-tracking methods to JobExecutor
userStories.description: As a developer, I need submit_job, await_job, and await_all on JobExecutor so the HTTP layer can schedule background work and wait for tasks to finish on cancel or shutdown.
acceptanceCriteria: Add self._tasks: dict[str, asyncio.Task] to JobExecutor.__init__
submit_job(job_def) -> JobState creates and stores an asyncio.Task running the existing run_job, returns the initial JobState
await_job(job_id, timeout) awaits the tracked task for the given job_id, raising on timeout
await_all(timeout) awaits all tracked tasks (used during lifespan shutdown)
Completed tasks are removed from _tasks automatically
Existing run_job / cancel_job behaviour is unchanged
userStories.notes: Added _tasks dict, submit_job, await_job, await_all, and _run_job_from_state to JobExecutor. 315 tests pass. Commit 63a3e5c.

userStories.title: Create /jobs REST router
userStories.description: As Solar Control, I need POST /jobs, GET /jobs/{id}, and DELETE /jobs/{id} endpoints on the host so I can submit, inspect, and cancel containerised jobs over HTTP.
acceptanceCriteria: Create host/solar_host/routes/jobs.py with APIRouter(prefix='/jobs', tags=['jobs'])
Define Pydantic models: JobSubmitRequest (superset of JobDefinition plus submission_id/correlation_id), JobSubmitResponse, JobStateResponse, StepStateResponse
POST /jobs: validates request, calls executor.submit_job, returns 202 with job_id/status/workspace_path/submission_id/correlation_id

GET /jobs/{id}: returns 200 JobStateResponse including all JobState fields, per-step log_file path (JOBS_DIR/<job-id>/logs/<step_name>.log), and recent_logs (tail of in-memory buffer capped at 100 entries)
DELETE /jobs/{id}: synchronously cancel_job -> await_job(timeout=10s) -> delete_workspace -> step_log_buffer.remove -> store.remove, returns 200 {detail: 'cancelled', job_id}
Single error-to-HTTP mapping helper: ValueError->400, KeyError (duplicate)->409, InsufficientDiskError->507, WorkspaceError->500, GpuValidationError->400, executor None->503
userStories.notes: Created solar_host/routes/jobs.py with JobSubmitRequest/JobSubmitResponse/StepStateResponse/JobStateResponse, three handlers, and _map_error helper. Commit dd35f90.

userStories.title: Wire /jobs router into main.py and lifespan shutdown
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the new router registered with the FastAPI app and graceful task draining on shutdown so the host exposes the endpoints and does not orphan running tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: app.include_router(jobs.router) added in host/solar_host/main.py
await job_executor.await_all(timeout=30) called in the shutdown branch of the lifespan context manager, before stopping Docker/other clients
App starts and /jobs routes are reachable
userStories.notes: Router registered and await_all(timeout=30) added to lifespan shutdown. Commit dd35f90.

userStories.title: Add integration tests for /jobs endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a comprehensive test suite for the new routes so regressions are caught before merge.
acceptanceCriteria: Create host/tests/test_routes_jobs.py using TestClient(app) and mocking DockerService the same way test_job_executor.py does
POST happy path: 202, JobState in store, background task scheduled (run_job mocked to immediate coroutine)
POST 400: empty steps, traversal job_id (../etc), missing required field
POST 409: same job_id submitted twice while first is running
POST 503: app.state.job_executor = None
POST 507: monkeypatched check_disk_space raises InsufficientDiskError
POST with correlation metadata: submission_id/correlation_id round-trip into store and into GET response
GET happy path: full payload including workspace_path, per-step log_file paths, recent_logs from step_log_buffer
GET 404: unknown job id
DELETE happy path on running job: 200, store entry gone, delete_workspace called
DELETE 404: unknown job id
DELETE 409: terminal job (status completed/failed/cancelled)
Auth smoke test: missing or wrong X-API-Key returns 401
userStories.notes: Created tests/test_routes_jobs.py with 14 tests covering all happy paths and error paths (400/409/503/507), correlation round-trip, and auth smoke test. All 329 tests pass. Commit ea52f08.
